items.name: oneko
items.title: Oneko
items.description: Cursor-following cat sprite for React (client-only). Based on the oneko.js idea; mounts on document.body with optional bubbles, sounds, and tweakable motion.
items.author: dhrv <https://oneko.dhrv.pw>
items.docs: Use with `dynamic(..., { ssr: false })` in Next.js App Router so the sprite only runs in the browser. Optional: add sound files under `public/cat-sounds/` (see the oneko repo) if you want full audio; the sprite sheet loads from the upstream oneko.js GIF URL by default.
